clarifications.attempt_policy: Exactly one consumable attempt is permitted. It must be bound after this registration to one fresh absolute run directory and uniquely timeline-anchored. Any interruption is terminal INCOMPLETE; there is no retry, resume, or alternate run directory.
clarifications.comparison_arms: PHI1 and HETERO_FIXED are the fixed-lattice comparators; FP is the unquantized capacity comparator. LIVE_WD0 is the registered prospective benefit arm. LIVE_WD05 is a weight-decay mechanism contrast only.
clarifications.diversity_timepoint: Route diversity is evaluated at each live arm's primary hard-generalization confirmation checkpoint, not at its terminal checkpoint.
clarifications.evaluation_priority: Hard evaluation is primary and soft evaluation is secondary. LEGACY_DEAD hard evaluation resolves the all-zero router-logit tie to ternary lattice index 0.
clarifications.fixed_heterogeneous_assignment: HETERO_FIXED uses the preregistered arbitrary, deterministic per-layer lattice assignment. It is a fixed heterogeneity comparator, not a claim that the assignment is optimal or naturally privileged.
clarifications.gumbel_schedule: Shared Gumbel tensors have shape [steps, 7, 3], use the preregistered stable task offsets and seed formula, are generated by a dedicated CPU generator in float32, clamp uniform draws at 1e-6, and transform them as -log(-log(U)). Layer order and lattice index order are fixed by the preregistered config.
clarifications.heterogeneous_only_rule: The conservative HETEROGENEITY_SUFFICES rule requires HETERO_FIXED to beat PHI1 and both live modes under the full registered score and guards. Any tie with either live mode maps to NO_BOUNDED_ROUTER_BENEFIT rather than HETEROGENEITY_SUFFICES.
clarifications.leakage_invalidation: P4 is checked across every registered evaluation mode for every shuffled-label control. Any shuffled FP native-mode generalization or any LIVE_WD0 hard- or soft-mode generalization yields INVALID_LEAKAGE_CONTROL.
clarifications.mixture_only_rule: MIXTURE_ONLY_ROUTER_BENEFIT requires LIVE_WD0 soft to beat LEGACY_DEAD soft, PHI1, and HETERO_FIXED under the complete registered score and floor/memorization guards while the complete hard adaptive/global rule fails.
clarifications.nominal_parameter_parity: Unused shadow parameters equalize nominal parameter counts across arms only. They do not establish equal functional capacity, optimization geometry, or active degrees of freedom.
clarifications.optimizer_determinism: AdamW is instantiated with foreach=false and fused=false. After canonical initialization and explicit schedule construction, training and evaluation do not consume the global random-number generator.
clarifications.post_preregistration_probe_disclosure: After timeline sequence 266 and only to test the implementation, three bounded CPU probes were observed: the graph repair gate at seed 5700, a three-update deterministic LIVE clone gate, and a two-update FP Z2xZ2xZ2 seed-5700 artifact-closure cell with neither memorization nor generalization. These probes did not change registered seeds, predictions, horizons, arms, gates, or verdict rules.
clarifications.propositions_and_verdict: P1 through P4 are reported independently. P2 may pass while the top-level verdict remains NO_BOUNDED_ROUTER_BENEFIT because the stronger fixed-comparator and diversity conditions are separate.
clarifications.score_and_guards: Scores compare sustained-generalization count first. On a count tie, the mean confirmation step (nongeneralizing cells censored at 20800) must be at least 800 steps earlier; every pairwise benefit comparison also requires no lower memorization count. Each comparator is subject to its per-arm easy-floor guard. OPTIMIZATION_FLOOR is emitted only if no arm reaches at least 3 of 4 easy-task seeds.
clarifications.verdict_scope: Adaptive/global router verdicts require P2, improvement over both PHI1 and HETERO_FIXED under the full score and guards, and diverse routes at hard-generalization confirmation. The assay is tiny random-point interpolation, not structural OOD, universal routing evidence, or a frontier-scale neural-network result.
clarifications.windows_gpu_scope: The Windows lock is cooperative namespace exclusivity. Together with the registered idle samples and process checks it is bounded interference evidence, not absolute exclusion of every non-cooperating Windows GPU client.
clarifications.runtime_disclosure: The exact CUDA execution path has not been performance-benchmarked. The 2-4 hour reservation is an extrapolation, not a registered result or stopping rule.

review_gate: Independent pre-execution reviews GO: 16 tests and compilation pass; graph repair, determinism, all verdict branches, all-mode leakage invalidation, exact 56-cell artifact reduction/replay, result-chain tamper detection, terminal checkpoint replay, cooperative GPU locking, and provisional-to-final sealing were checked.
